notes: First release: a free word processor for Windows that opens and saves Word documents (.docx) and keeps the parts it doesn't edit exactly as they were.
Eight templates and six designs, a command palette (Ctrl+K), slash commands, Markdown shortcuts and autocorrect that one Ctrl+Z undoes.
Pictures that stay put, lists that number as expected, paste that matches your document, Reveal formatting, visible breaks and no stray blank last page.
Automatic save, recovery copies and version history; tables of contents, footnotes, captions, cross-references, citations, comments and track changes.
Urdu and Arabic turn a paragraph right-to-left by themselves, with Noto Nastaliq Urdu and Noto Naskh Arabic included.
Opens Markdown, text, RTF, ODT and web pages; exports PDF, Markdown, a web page and plain text.
